context:
Merged as PR 3248 (2026-10-24). Z-order now runs once after each table loads: apply_post_load_tunings runs OPTIMIZE <t> ZORDER BY (clustering columns, then distribution columns) on the physical table, recorded in the post_load ledger phase, replacing the plain OPTIMIZE for that table. The pre-load OPTIMIZE and ZORDER are gone from apply_table_tunings. Partition columns are dropped from the Z-order list. If the ZORDER statement fails it is recorded as z_order skipped, the post_load maintenance phase reports FAILED, and plain OPTIMIZE and ANALYZE still run for that table when enable_delta_optimization is on. Tests: tests/unit/platforms/test_post_load_seam.py (ZORDER follows the load with a fake driver, failure fallback, isolation between tables, partition-column exclusion, one OPTIMIZE per table on success); 38 passed there and 6307 passed on tests/unit/platforms + tests/unit/core with -m medium. Not run against a live Databricks workspace.

Affected published bundles: none. All 51 Databricks bundles in results-data/ and on the published-results branch record a resolved clustering strategy of none and no requested tuning, so no published result used z_order.

Strategy resolution is unchanged and tracked separately: _resolve_databricks_clustering_strategy (adapter.py ~407-413) promotes strategy none plus clustering or distribution columns to z_order, also for an explicit none; see databricks-explicit-none-strategy-promoted-to-zorder. The reviewer withdrew its objection to that on the final head. The CHANGELOG and docs/reference/python-api/platforms/databricks.md describe the rule.
description:
## Problem
Tuning is applied before the load (`benchbox/platforms/base/adapter.py:948`; the load runs at `:971`). For Z-order strategies, the tuning step runs `OPTIMIZE … ZORDER BY` (`benchbox/platforms/databricks/adapter.py:3260,3364`), which acts on empty tables. After the load, `apply_post_load_tunings` runs a plain `OPTIMIZE` (`:3427`), and there is no other ZORDER call site.

Every Databricks Z-order tuned result therefore measured compaction only, while the ledger records `z_order` as applied. No test runs Z-order after a load.

## Change
- When the strategy is `z_order`, run `OPTIMIZE <t> ZORDER BY (<cols>)` in the post-load step and record it as a post_load ledger statement.
- Drop the pre-load `OPTIMIZE`.
- Add a unit test with a fake driver asserting the ZORDER statement is issued after the load.
- List published Databricks Z-order tuned bundles that are affected.
